threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a ‘short walk’ means 10 minutes, not 30. And you avoid the footbridge over the river like it's a London Marathon on a Sunday.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken on the 196 last night, only to find a guy with a saxophone playing along. Best £1.75 I ever spent.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The sound of a random street musician mixing techno with folk tunes outside my window at 2 AM—only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous techno party in a laundromat at 2 AM, complete with a DJ and dancers spinning while clothes tumble.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they navigate BART delays. A tourist panics, but a local just shrugs and knows the bus is even worse.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo get on the 31, sipping a coffee like it was a wedding reception. Only in SF do you see wedding attire on the way to work.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think they can just stroll into a plaça and find a seat. Local families have claimed them by 9 AM for the entire day!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still get flustered at the absurdity of the bus schedules, checking their phones every two minutes, while the locals just roll their eyes and wait.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newbies by their confusion during the tube strike; they’re the ones asking if the 38 bus still runs all night.
Caught a night bus home from Brixton, and a guy was arguing with a mannequin he thought was his mate. Only in South London, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a stray cat lounging in a Berlin U-Bahn seat, completely unfazed by the crowded train. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how Kreuzberg has more Spätis open all night than anywhere else? It's like a life support system for night owls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know which BART station to avoid when there's smoke—Civic Center's closed, but they're still catching a ride elsewhere.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy singing opera on the 47 while a woman in a business suit filmed him. He ended with a bow, and we all applauded. Just another day on Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí houses, but go down Carrer de Juan Ramón Jiménez for authentic local cafés. It's a different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their struggle with the metro ticket machines; they still hit the screen like it’s a slot machine.
